lead.headline: Sadiq limited again; the flex still sits a point off the projection
lead.deck: Your only tight end has been limited twice with his back. Andrews is free if he sits. Downs still belongs in the flex.
lead.body: Kenyon Sadiq, the only tight end on this roster, was limited again Thursday with the back injury, the same line as Wednesday, and no Jets coach has spoken to his availability. No bench player can cover the slot, so the plan stays on the wire: if he is ruled out Friday or inactive at 09:30 Sunday, add Mark Andrews, a free agent who practised fully Thursday, and drop Carnell Tate. The other item is still undone. The flex has had Bhayshul Tuten in it since Wednesday night; ESPN prefers Josh Downs by a point, a coin flip, and coin flips go to the projection. Downs locks at 07:30 Sunday in London. One miss to record: Zach Charbonnet, whom the log said to re-add for nothing once Seattle activated him, was added by KEI returns on Wednesday night. Across the matchup, Team 13's DeVonta Smith missed Thursday and Rachaad White has missed both days.
